page.content:
Shubert house that held The Phantom of the Opera for decades.

How Majestic Theatre connects

  • Work: The Phantom of the Opera — The Phantom of the Opera ran at the Majestic Theatre.
  • Faction: The Shubert Organization — The Majestic Theatre is a Shubert house.

What is Majestic Theatre?

The Majestic Theatre on 44th Street is the Shubert house whose chandelier and underground lair housed The Phantom of the Opera from 1988 through the end of its original Broadway run.

Key threads lead to The Phantom of the Opera and The Shubert Organization.
